title: Make the program dashboard live: near-real-time data and the animated decision-network replay
story: As the sponsor I want the one program dashboard to update itself in near real time and replay how work moved through the organisation so that I can watch the program, not a frozen snapshot
acceptance: Sponsor feedback (2026-10-19): the merged dashboard is static; the old live board (dashboard/live.html) showed near-real-time and historical movement visually. Port that behaviour into dashboard/app.js so dashboard/live.html is no longer needed by the sponsor

Live data layer copied from live.html (lines ~413-436): on load render the embedded snapshot, then const db = await window.claude?.use?.("db"); if db, subscribe ONCE to db.collection("live").onSnapshot and re-render from the documents board, rank, graph, events and a new metrics document; else, when served by dashboard/server.mjs, poll /api/live/<name> every 5 s; else stay on the snapshot. Never subscribe inside render. A header pill shows the source (live / local / snapshot) and the age of the data (updated 2 min ago), turning amber after 30 min

Decision network tab: the animated canvas from live.html (event pulses travelling along the edge each recorded event happened on, Replay button that plays the real event order time-compressed, a timeline scrubber, Follow live toggle, recently-active edges lit, legend and filters), keyboard-operable controls, light and dark; the static SVG from S6-PMO-02 may be replaced
Sprint board and Agent rank views from live.html are available as tabs (or the existing Sprint board/Performance tabs gain the live board columns and stack rank), driven by the live documents

org/live-export.mjs also writes org/live/metrics.json = the dashboard computeMetrics output (from dashboard/server.mjs build) plus generatedAt, so Velocity, Quality, Cost, Flow and Performance tabs update live; every document stays under 600 KB (test)

Playwright: the snapshot file still renders every tab offline with no errors; a second test serves the dashboard locally, changes org/live data, and sees the page update within 10 s; screenshots dashboard-network.png (mid-replay) and dashboard-overview.png; full npm test no new failures
brief: Read dashboard/live.html fully first (network renderer, replay, scrub, followLive, data loader) and the S6-PMO-02 changes in dashboard/app.js. Zero dependencies (no d3 from CDN; reuse the canvas code). The orchestrator publishes snapshot.html with capabilities {db} and writes the live documents with ArtifactData after each wave.

verdicts.reason: All 6 criteria met; 43 own tests pass incl. Playwright offline/live-update; no src/ changes so no full-suite gate. Orchestrator must re-run org/live-export.mjs to write org/live/metrics.json
